config.scoring: whole-tile (comparable with earlier runs) and unique-area (each tile scored only over its own stride cell, so the 50% overlap between neighbouring holdout tiles is counted once)
config.threshold_policy: 0.5 fixed; plus a threshold chosen on VALIDATION (max F1) and frozen before test -- reported separately as test_at_val_threshold
config.note: K positives region-stratified, re-sampled per seed; negatives fixed. K='all' is the full-training-set reference, not a ceiling.
